name: wybe-connect
description: Feeds your Wybe AI colleague from Cursor. Hooks record your prompts and the files edited (sessions:light), plus the agent's replies and tool I/O (sessions:full), redacted on your machine, and send them at every stop. Sends only, and never reads what your colleague knows; the one thing that comes back is your colleague's open questions, shown at session start and at most one after a turn as a follow-up, for you to answer or not.
